content: निधिः [नि-धा-आधारे कि] .²1 Abode, receptacle, reservoir; जल˚, तोय˚, तपोनिधि <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A store-house, treasury. .²3 A treasure, store, hoard (for the nine treasures of Kubera, see नवनिधि). .²4 The ocean. .²5 An epithet of Viṣṇu. .²6 A man endowed with many good qualities. .²7 the science of chronology; <ls>Ch. Up. 7. 2. 1</ls>.
